newsitem.title: USA: AST Research to be bought by Samsung.
newsitem.headline: AST Research to be bought by Samsung.

text.p: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd will launch a tender offer to buy the remaining stake of AST Research Inc it does not currently own for $5.40 a share cash or about $170 million, the companies said on Tuesday.

Samsung will be buying about 31 million shares of AST common stock outstanding. Samsung and its affiliates currently own about 46 percent of the outstanding shares of AST Common Stock, and have options which, if exercised, would result in ownership of about 49 percent of the outstanding AST shares.
The tender offer will begin on April 21, 1997 and expire at 1700 EDT/2100 GMT on May 19, 1997, unless extended.

"AST's customers and vendors should have renewed confidence in the company's abilities and resources following completion of the acquisition," said Y.S. Kim, AST's president and chief executive officer.
The AST board of directors approved the merger agreement and tender offer, the company said.
A memorandum of understanding has also been entered into with representatives of stockholders that have class action suits filed in Delaware Chancery Court.

The MOU provides for the settlement, subject to court approval, under which the Delware class actions would be dismissed. These suits were filed following Samsung's January 30, 1997 proposal to the AST common for $5.10 per share.
Samsung is being advised by Salomon Brothers Inc.
The tender is subject to approval by various foreign government officials and the expiration of the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act.
